description.en: Removes the extra motions loaded onto a character with CMND_LOAD_MOTION. The events pass -1, which by its use removes them all. CMND_DELETE_CHARA uses the same routine for match players.
Which motions to remove; -1 for all (as the events pass).

The routine's result (true if something was removed).
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: After a scene (real usage, from ev42101400.nut)
